title: Hybrid thiazolyl–benzylidene–phenol metal complexes as novel chemotherapeutic agents with anti-topoisomerase I activity in human breast carcinoma: synthesis, in vitro and in silico studies
content:

A new ligand, benzylidene–phenol–thiazole (HBHTP), and its M(II) complexes (M = Co, Ni, Cu, or Zn) were synthesized using a hybrid pharmacophore approach.
